seo.title: Izoh — guest feedback by QR
seo.description: Izoh helps teams collect guest reviews, complaints and suggestions by QR, get alerts in Telegram, and gently invite happy guests to leave public reviews.
seo.keywords: Izoh, guest feedback, QR feedback, customer reviews, guest complaints, guest suggestions, public reviews, Google reviews, Yandex Maps reviews, 2GIS reviews
seo.ogImageAlt: Izoh helps collect guest reviews, complaints and suggestions by QR

hero.title: Listen to guests in time
hero.subtitle: A guest scans the QR and shares a review, complaint, or idea. The team instantly sees the place, photo, and details in Telegram.

scan.before: A guest scans the QR and
scan.accent: shares their impression in the moment

features.title: Everything a guest said, in one place
features.subtitle: Reviews, complaints, ideas, photos, and places arrive where your team already works.

guest.title: The guest tells you first
guest.body: The QR opens a short screen: review, complaint, suggestion, or a note about a staff member.

alert.title: Complaints arrive in the moment
alert.body: A low rating, text, and place go straight to the team while there is still time to respond.

idea.title: Suggestions do not get lost
idea.body: Guests can share what to improve, add, or notice in the service.

public.title: Good experiences support reputation
public.body: After a high rating, Izoh gently suggests leaving a review on the platform you choose.

visualAlt.guest: Choosing a feedback type in Izoh
visualAlt.public: Choosing a public review platform in Izoh

context.title: Context to understand faster
context.subtitle: Who was mentioned, where it happened, what repeats, and whether there is a photo — all next to the request.

staff.title: Staff
staff.body: A guest can mention an employee or the whole team, so it is clear who was thanked or where to look closer.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: See which ratings, complaints, topics, and places repeat most often.

photos.title: Photos in requests
photos.body: Photos help the team understand the situation faster and without long follow-ups.

ratingFlow.title: How Izoh helps you respond in time
ratingFlow.subtitle: Negative feedback reaches the team first, and a good experience can turn into a public review.

teamFirst.accent: is heard by the team first

details.before: If something is wrong, it is clear

forWhom.title: For places where reputation matters
forWhom.subtitle: When guests come every day, it matters to hear them in the moment: handle the hard things and keep the good ones.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Short answers about launch, guests, team work, and public reviews.

install.question: Does a guest need to install an app?
install.answer: No. The guest opens the screen by QR, and the team works in Telegram.

lowRating.question: What happens with a low rating?
lowRating.answer: The team receives it inside Izoh with the details, so they have time to understand what happened.

teamSees.question: What does the team see?
teamSees.answer: Rating, text, photo, place, and who the guest mentioned if staff is enabled.

publicReviews.question: Can public reviews be configured?
publicReviews.answer: Yes. Choose the platforms and the rating after which Izoh gently shows this step.

notOnlyRestaurants.question: Is Izoh only for restaurants?
notOnlyRestaurants.answer: No. Izoh works for places with guests, customers, or visitors.

footer.title: Start hearing guests first
footer.subtitle: Place a QR and collect reviews, complaints, and suggestions in the moment.
